ayahs.1: Ae Nabi! (Apni ummat se kaho ke) jab tum apni biwiyon ko talaaq dena chaaho to un ki iddat (ke dinon ke aaghaaz) mein unhein talaaq do aur iddat ka hisaab rakho, aur Allah se jo tumhara Parwardigaar hai darte raho, na tum unhein un ke gharon se nikaalo aur na woh (khud) niklein haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh khuli buraai kar baithen, yeh Allah ki muqarrar-karda hadein hain, jo shakhs Allah ki hadon se aage badh jaaye is ne yaqeenan apne upar zulm kiya, tum nahin jaante shaayad is ke baad Allah Taala koi nayi baat paida kar de.
ayahs.2: Pas jab yeh auratein apni iddat poori karne ke qareeb pahunch jaayen to unhein ya to qaaiday ke mutaabiq apne nikaah mein rehne do ya dastoor ke mutaabiq unhein alag kar do aur aapas mein se do aadil shakhs ko gawaah kar lo aur Allah ki raza-mandi ke liye theek theek gawaahi do. Yehi hai woh jis ki naseehat ise ki jaati hai jo Allah par aur qayamat ke din par imaan rakhta ho aur jo shakhs Allah se darta hai Allah is ke liye chhutkaare ki shakl nikaal deta hai.
ayahs.3: Aur ise aisi jagah se rozee deta hai jis ka ise gumaan bhi na ho aur jo shakhs Allah par tawakkul karega Allah ise kaafi hoga. Allah Taala apna kaam poora karke hi rahega. Allah Taala ne har cheez ka ek andaaza muqarrar kar rakha hai.
ayahs.4: Tumhari auraton mein se jo auratein haiz se na-umeed ho gayi hon, agar tumhein shubha ho to un ki iddat teen maheene hai aur un ki bhi jinhein haiz aana shuru hi na hua ho aur haamila auraton ki iddat un ke waz-e-haml hai aur jo shakhs Allah Taala se darega Allah is ke (har) kaam mein aasaani kar dega.
ayahs.5: Yeh Allah ka hukm hai jo is ne tumhari taraf utaara hai aur jo shakhs Allah se darega Allah is ke gunaah mita dega aur ise bada bhaari ajr dega.
ayahs.6: Tum apni taaqat ke mutaabiq jahan tum rehte ho wahan un (talaaq wali) auraton ko rakho aur unhein tang karne ke liye takleef na pahunchaao aur agar woh hamal se hon to jab tak bachcha paida ho le unhein kharch dete raha karo phir agar tumhare kehne se wohi doodh pilaayen to tum unhein un ki ujrat de do aur baaham munaasib taur par mashwara kar liya karo aur agar tum aapas mein kashmakash karo to is ke kehne se koi aur doodh pilaayegi.
ayahs.7: Kushaadgi wale ko apni kushaadgi se kharch karna chahiye aur jis par is ke rizq ki tangi ki gayi ho ise chahiye ke jo kuchh Allah Taala ne ise de rakha hai isi mein se (apni hasb-e-haisiyat) de, kisi shakhs ko Allah takleef nahin deta magar itni hi jitni taaqat ise de rakhi hai, Allah tangi ke baad aasaani-o-faraaghat bhi kar dega.
ayahs.8: Aur bahut si basti walon ne apne Rabb ke hukm se aur is ke Rasoolon se sartaabi ki to hum ne bhi un se sakht hisaab kiya aur unhein azaab diya an-dekha (sakht) azaab.
ayahs.9: Pas unhon ne apne kartoot ka maza chakh liya aur anjaam-e-kaar un ka khasaara hi hua.
ayahs.10: Un ke liye Allah Taala ne sakht azaab taiyaar kar rakha hai, pas Allah se daro ae aql-mand imaan walo. Yaqeenan Allah ne tumhari taraf naseehat utaar di hai.
ayahs.11: (Yaani) Rasool jo tumhein Allah ke saaf saaf ahkaam padh sunaata hai taake un logon ko jo imaan laayen aur nek amal karen woh taareekiyon se roshni ki taraf le aaye, aur jo shakhs Allah par imaan laaye aur nek amal kare Allah ise aisi jannaton mein daakhil karega jis ke neeche nehrein jaari hain jin mein yeh hamesha hamesha rahenge. Beshak Allah ne ise behtareen rozee de rakhi hai.
ayahs.12: Allah woh hai jis ne saat aasman banaaye aur isi ke misl zameenein bhi. Is ka hukm un ke darmiyan utarta hai taake tum jaan lo ke Allah har cheez par qaadir hai. Aur Allah Taala ne har cheez ko ba-itibaar-e-ilm gher rakha hai.
